findings.red_before_evidence: File existed at commit 3b8befb0112cfe2d314ad65964762a3fb251e710 violating allowed paths whitelist.
findings.green_after_evidence: File deleted. Verified PEP 420 namespace package imports work cleanly on Python 3.12 and Python 3.13 without this file.

findings.red_before_evidence: AUDIT_MANIFEST_INSPECTION_RECEIPT.json reported 2,933,280 rows, omitting 1,440 minutes from leap day 2024-02-29.
findings.green_after_evidence: AUDIT_MANIFEST_CORRECTION_RECEIPT.json reconciles canonical count 2,934,720 (2,038 calendar days * 1,440 min). Sum of 67 monthly partitions metadata lengths invariant verified. Physical availability of ETH/SOL status confirmed UNKNOWN.

findings.red_before_evidence: tests/test_strategy_research_r3_repair_regressions.py::test_a03_fill_ack_preserves_position_max_hold_ms and test_a03_no_zombie_resurrection_after_same_minute_stop_loss FAILED with early EXPIRY and zombie double close.
findings.green_after_evidence: Both A03 regression tests PASS. max_hold_ms preserved through ACK; same-minute closed position tracked in closed_position_ids and never resurrected.

findings.red_before_evidence: tests/test_strategy_research_r3_repair_regressions.py::test_a04_candidate_isolation_breakout_state and test_a04_signal_isolation_order_invariance FAILED with cross-candidate breakout leakage and evaluation order dependence.
findings.green_after_evidence: Both A04 regression tests PASS. SignalGenerator._active_breakouts keyed by (candidate_id, symbol, direction). ReplayEngine assigns dedicated SignalGenerator instances per candidate.

A05 regression test PASS. Long requires band_lower <= current_1h.low <= band_upper; short requires band_lower <= current_1h.high <= band_upper. Breakout bar extrema included in stop distance calculation.

findings.red_before_evidence: tests/test_strategy_research_r3_repair_regressions.py::test_a06_mark_available_in_stage_1_and_close_time_freshness FAILED (mark processed in Stage 2 with candle open timestamp).
findings.green_after_evidence: A06 regression test PASS. Mark updates processed in Stage 1 with close_ms timestamp. Future mark rejection enforced.

findings.red_before_evidence: tests/test_strategy_research_r3_repair_regressions.py::test_a07_cooldown_starts_from_economic_exit FAILED (cooldown started at ACK arrival, 4h dedup args omitted).
findings.green_after_evidence: A07 regression test PASS. Cooldown starts from ceil_to_minute(trade.exit_time_ms) + 4h. Order sizing compares signal.available_at_ms. ReplayEngine passes last_exit_time_ms and last_entry_4h_time_ms.

findings.red_before_evidence: tests/test_strategy_research_r3_repair_regressions.py::test_a08_exit_commitment_includes_tick_size_and_retained_reserves FAILED (c_exit omitted tick_size * qty; active position reserves dropped).
findings.green_after_evidence: A08 regression test PASS. c_exit incorporates tick_size * quantity. Outstanding commitments retain exit and funding reserves until Stage 1 exit ACK releases them.
